refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: verifyctl asks platformd-verifyd.service8 to verify that the current user is present, by running the configured factors in the platformd-verify PAM service. It is a client of the io.platformd.Verify varlink7 interface. A user may only verify itself.

listitem.para: Verify that the current user is present, optionally with a human-readable REASON. Prints whether the user was verified and the PAM service that ran. PAM informational and error messages are printed to standard error while verification is running. No authentication responses are read or displayed by this command. On services without VerifyUserWithMessages, the command uses VerifyUser without message delivery. Only MethodNotFound before any message permits this fallback; a started verification is never retried.

Verify presence with application-supplied context read from a regular JSON file of at most 4096 bytes. The object must contain exactly challengeHex, audience, and operationDigestHex. The challenge and operation digest each encode 32 bytes in hexadecimal. The audience is a nonempty string of at most 256 printable ASCII bytes. Hexadecimal values are converted to lowercase; the audience is not normalized. Context must not contain secrets.

The command uses VerifyUserWithContext and never falls back to another method. Message delivery and the result have the same meaning as for verify. A successful result does not establish measurement or acceptance by a remote service. The remote verifier must require the exact context in complete, challenge-bound evidence and apply its own expiry and replay policy. The application defines the request bytes covered by the operation digest.
Print a short help text and exit.

refsect1.title: Exit status
refsect1.para: 0 is returned if the user was verified, a non-zero code otherwise. This status does not report whether an authentication event was recorded or accepted by a remote verifier.

listitem.para: The directory holding the io.platformd.Verify socket. Defaults to /run/platformd-verifyd.
